title: Add disabled watch-folder detection and optional launch
summary: Add an off-by-default desktop watch-folder manager that detects newly stable files under configured or derived source roots, surfaces pending work, and optionally requests backend Run Once through the existing launch gate.
behavior_before: The desktop app did not keep a background watch-folder status model; operators had to launch or refresh manually after files arrived in source roots.
behavior_after: When EnableWatchFolders is false, behavior is unchanged. When enabled, the local API host scans watch roots, debounces stable file changes, records pending detections, exposes read-only status, and can optionally request backend Run Once through the existing guarded launch path.
manual_validation: Started local API on http://127.0.0.1:8765 with explicit token; /api/health returned startup_progress complete including watch_folders=disabled; Browser DOM smoke verified schedule-watch-folder-status/summary/recent exist and status text is Disabled; stopped PID 60484 and confirmed port no longer listening.
py_compile passed for changed watch/API/facade Python files and new watch tests.
